dashboard.heading: Welcome back, {shopName}
dashboard.subheading: Here's the current status of your shop.

settings.heading: Shop settings
settings.currencyHint: The currency new products are priced in. Products you've already listed keep the currency they were priced in.
settings.countryHint: Decides which of your shipping rates counts as domestic.
settings.avatarHint: Square works best. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

products.heading: Products
products.empty: You haven't added any products yet.

productForm.heading: New product
productForm.subheading: Add a product and its variants.
productForm.imagesHint: Add a few photos of your product.
productForm.optionsHint: Add options like Color or Size to create multiple variants. Leave empty for a single-variant product.
productForm.valuePlaceholder: Add a value and press Enter
productForm.editSubheading: Update this product and its variants.
productForm.statusHint: Turn this off to hide the product from your shop without deleting it. You can list it again at any time.
productForm.maxOptionsReached: You can add up to {count} options.
productForm.applyToAllHint: Fills every included variant with the base price plus its option adjustments. You can still edit rows individually afterwards.
productForm.tooManyVariants: Too many combinations — a product can have at most {count} variants. Remove some option values or exclude combinations.
productForm.tracksInventoryHint: Turn this off for made-to-order or digital items that never run out. Stock numbers are ignored while it's off.
productForm.shippingHint: Pick a profile, or leave as free shipping to cover postage yourself.
productForm.imagesRemaining: {count, plural, one {# more photo can be added} other {# more photos can be added}}
productForm.imagesTooMany: A product can have at most {max} photos.

shipping.heading: Shipping profiles
shipping.subheading: Reusable postage rates you can assign to products — a small parcel costs less to send than a large one.
shipping.empty: No shipping profiles yet. Products without one ship free.
shipping.destinationHint: Use a two-letter country code, or * for everywhere else. A destination with no matching rate can't be ordered.
shipping.flatRateHint: Set “each additional” to 0 to charge one flat rate per order, however many the buyer adds.

payouts.heading: Payouts
payouts.subheading: How you get paid for what you sell.
payouts.explainNotStarted: Set up payouts to start selling. Stripe handles the details and pays the money into your bank account.
payouts.explainIncomplete: Stripe still needs a few details before it can pay you.
payouts.explainReviewing: Stripe is checking the details you provided. This usually takes a day or two.
payouts.explainActionNeeded: Stripe has paused payouts and needs more information from you.
payouts.explainConnected: Payouts are active. Stripe pays out on its own schedule; the dashboard shows what's on its way.
payouts.stripeHint: Payments and payouts are handled by Stripe. Card details and identity documents go to Stripe, never to us.

orders.heading: Orders
orders.awaiting: {count, plural, one {# order needs your answer} other {# orders need your answer}}
orders.shipHint: The buyer is told it's on its way. Add a tracking number if there is one.
orders.cancelHint: The buyer gets their money back in full and the items return to your stock. This can't be undone.
orders.payoutNotReclaimed: Your share couldn't be taken back automatically — we'll be in touch.
orders.payoutOnHold: Payout on hold while the reported problem is sorted out.
orders.payoutDue: Released {date}, or as soon as the buyer confirms it arrived.
orders.payoutAfterDelivery: Released once the order is marked as delivered.
orders.disputeHeld: The buyer reported a problem. Your payout is on hold until it's sorted out.
orders.disputedCount: {count, plural, one {# order has a reported problem} other {# orders have reported problems}}
orders.refundHint: This settles the reported problem and returns the full amount. Stock isn't added back, since the parcel has already gone.

Cart.heading: Your cart
Cart.someUndeliverable: Some items can't be shipped to your selected country.

shop.heading: Shop
shop.empty: This shop has nothing listed right now.

browse.heading: All products
browse.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing here} one {# item} other {# items}}
browse.noResults: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try a shorter word, or browse a category.

Checkout.heading: Checkout
Checkout.accountModeLabel: How you want to check out
Checkout.loginHint: Signed in, your address is filled in for you and the order is saved to your account.
Checkout.registerHint: The account is created along with the order — no separate step. We'll use the name from the delivery address below, and you'll find your orders and messages to the shop in your account.
Checkout.signInRequired: Log in above to place your order.
Checkout.paymentNextStep: Payment is handled in the next step.
Checkout.secureNote: Your details are sent encrypted. The shop only ever sees your delivery address.
Checkout.countryHint: Changing this updates the shipping cost.
Checkout.undeliverableHint: Some items can't be shipped to this country. Remove them or choose another destination.
Checkout.splitHint: This basket will become {count} orders, one per shop — each seller ships and is paid separately.
Checkout.paymentFailed: The payment didn't go through. Try again or use another card.
Checkout.paymentUnavailable: Payments are unavailable right now. Please try again later.
Checkout.reservationHint: Your items are held for 30 minutes while you pay.

Order.heading: Thanks for your order
Order.subheading: Order {reference}. A confirmation is on its way to {email}.
Order.confirmingHint: This takes a few seconds. You can leave this page — we'll email you either way.
Order.problemHeld: The shop hasn't been paid while this is open. We'll be in touch.

actions.confirmed: Thanks — the shop has been paid.
actions.problemHint: The shop won't be paid while this is open, and we'll help sort it out.
actions.problemSent: Problem reported. We'll be in touch.
actions.withdrawPrompt: Has it turned up since you reported the problem?
actions.withdrawn: Problem closed. Thanks for letting us know.

Orders.heading: Your orders
Orders.signInRequired: Sign in to see your orders.

orderPlaced.subject: Order {reference} confirmed
orderPlaced.heading: Thanks for your order
orderPlaced.body: {shopName} has your order for {total}. They'll confirm shortly, and we'll email you again when it's on its way.

orderReceived.subject: New order #{orderNumber} — {total}
orderReceived.heading: You have a new order
orderReceived.body: {buyerName} ordered {total} from your shop. Accept it to let them know you're making it, or cancel to refund them in full.

orderAccepted.subject: {shopName} is preparing order {reference}
orderAccepted.heading: Your order is being prepared
orderAccepted.body: {shopName} has accepted your order and is getting it ready. We'll email you when it's posted.

orderShipped.subject: Order {reference} is on its way
orderShipped.heading: Your order has been sent
orderShipped.body: {shopName} has posted your order. Let us know once it arrives — that's what releases their payment.

orderShippedTracked.subject: Order {reference} is on its way
orderShippedTracked.heading: Your order has been sent
orderShippedTracked.body: {shopName} has posted your order. Tracking: {tracking}. Let us know once it arrives — that's what releases their payment.

deliveryNudge.subject: Has order {reference} arrived?
deliveryNudge.heading: Has it arrived?
deliveryNudge.body: {shopName} posted your order a few days ago. If it's here, confirming takes a second and pays them straight away. If it hasn't turned up, tell us and we'll hold their payment while we sort it out.

orderRefunded.subject: Order {reference} cancelled and refunded
orderRefunded.heading: Your order has been refunded
orderRefunded.body: {shopName} cancelled order {reference} and refunded {refunded}. Reason given: {reason}. It can take a few days to appear on your statement.

problemReported.subject: Problem reported on order #{orderNumber}
problemReported.heading: A buyer reported a problem
problemReported.body: {buyerName} reported a problem with order #{orderNumber}. They said: {reason}. Your payout for this order is on hold until it's settled — you can refund them from your shop, or we'll step in.

payoutReleased.subject: Payout released for order #{orderNumber}
payoutReleased.heading: You've been paid
payoutReleased.body: Order #{orderNumber} is complete and {payout} is on its way to your bank account on Stripe's usual schedule.

emailChanged.subject: Your email address was changed
emailChanged.heading: Your email address was changed
emailChanged.body: The address on your account is now {newEmail}. If you did this, nothing more is needed. If you did not, contact us straight away — you will no longer be able to sign in with this address.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: Every other device has been signed out. If you did this, nothing more is needed. If you did not, reset your password immediately and contact us.

accountClosed.subject: Your account has been closed
accountClosed.heading: Your account has been closed
accountClosed.body: Your name and email address have been removed. Orders and reviews are kept as required, but no longer carry your name. Thank you for having been here.

Reviews.heading: {count, plural, =0 {Reviews} one {# review} other {# reviews}}
Reviews.ratingLabel: {rating} out of 5, from {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}

email.emailHint: You sign in with this, and order confirmations go here.

password.heading: Password
password.signsOutOthers: Changing it signs out every other device.

close.heading: Close account
close.explainer: Your name and email address are removed. Orders and reviews are kept — the law requires the first and other shoppers rely on the second — but they no longer carry your name. This can't be undone.
close.confirmBody: Enter your password to confirm. You'll be signed out everywhere and won't be able to sign in again.
